reason: D-0017 recurring strand: pr-link's [skip ci] commit leaves required scaffold-check Expected forever on every PR; bounded 2-file workflow+test fix, proven by the next PR

quality.summary: Correct retrigger design: pr-link moves behind factory-scaffold completion (success + same-repo + PR-attached guards), preserves the story-resolution/already-linked logic and the skip-ci link commit verbatim, and carries scaffold-check to the new head as a status with provenance (source sha + run URL). The self-referential edge is handled by construction: on this change's own PR neither workflow version can fire, so the PR merges plainly. Content pins extended so a future edit that drops the guard pairing or the status context fails the suite.

non_blocking_findings.summary: The PR-body heredoc into GITHUB_OUTPUT uses a fixed EOF delimiter; a body line equal to EOF truncates parsing (degraded ticket detection, no privilege gain) — tolerable under the same-repo guard, random delimiter if it ever bites.
Only scaffold-check is carried; if branch protection later adds required contexts the strand returns for those — revisit trigger noted in D-0017's ledger entry.

residual_risks: workflow_run triggers execute the default-branch workflow file, so the new behavior arms only after merge; until then no pr-link fires on this PR by construction.

performance.summary: One extra API GET (PR body) and one POST (status) per link event; the job now runs once per scaffold completion instead of once per PR event wave, which is strictly fewer runs. No hot path — CI-side only.

security.summary: The carried status is a vouching primitive, so the lens is: can it vouch falsely? It posts only when the triggering factory-scaffold run CONCLUDED success on the same PR head lineage, from a same-repo PR, and the only diff between vouched-for and vouched-on heads is the bot's own events.jsonl commit. statuses:write is the minimal added permission; the token is repo-scoped. PR body is fetched server-side and enters only a python env var and a GITHUB_OUTPUT heredoc (collision noted in quality; no shell interpolation of the body occurs). Fork PRs are excluded by the head_repository guard.
residual_risks: A maintainer force-pushing between scaffold completion and the status POST could in principle receive the carried status on unrelated content; the window is seconds, the actor is a maintainer, and branch protection still requires the other checks — accepted.
